classifications.authority_or_basis: USA₮ primary launch material identifies Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. as issuer of the dollar-backed stablecoin and explicitly states that Tether Operations is not the issuer.

notes: Reviewed primary material establishes Anchorage Digital Bank as issuer, 1:1 USD redeemability and full liquid-reserve backing. Reserve ownership, segregation and bankruptcy remoteness are not inferred.

classifications.authority_or_basis: Anchorpoint primary material identifies HKDAP as an HKMA-licensed HKD-backed stablecoin issued by Anchorpoint Financial Limited and redeemable at HKD 1.00 per token.

licensed_or_regulated_as: Hong Kong Monetary Authority licensed stablecoin issuer
notes: Anchorpoint discloses a trust structure legally segregating reserve assets from operational assets. This record does not elevate that disclosure into a broader bankruptcy-remoteness conclusion.
